i made order do you know if it arrives with EU plug?

Yes. Every unit ships with the cord matched to the delivery address, so a Lithuanian address gets the EU plug.

The miner itself takes 100-240V on a standard IEC C14 inlet, so the power cord is the only region-specific part. If anything ever came through wrong, a normal IEC cable fixes it.

If you want me to confirm what's on your order, drop the order number here and I'll pull it up.
